diagnosis: The check C5 passed in all four rollouts because the settlement always assigned the 'support_owns_customer_updates' commitment to true, regardless of the hidden information. This boolean default value allowed the check to pass without needing the hidden fact PF3, which specifies the exact update interval.

C5.why: Northstar's contract changes the update interval from 60 to exactly 30 minutes, assigns the work to Support, and requires a commitment documenting that communication policy.
